cases.input: A program holds ProgramComponent membership assertions referencing two externally mastered projects and one transition to an externally mastered operation, against one joint benefit.
cases.expect: Membership, project mastership, transition acceptance and benefit observation remain distinct.

cases.input: One project closes while the other continues and the joint benefit is measurement-pending.
cases.expect: Project closure is recorded on the project master only; it emits no membership-end event, no outcome assertion and no realization assertion, and the joint benefit stays forecast with absent-reason measurement-pending.

cases.input: The program closes after handover while operational benefit observations continue.
cases.expect: Program closure records handover, benefit owner and residual obligations; realization observations continue against the external benefit master, referenced with absent-identifier reason identifier-unassigned, and no realization claim is made inside this contour.

cases.input: An unrelated folder of projects is labelled a program without mandate, joint hypothesis or dependency graph.
cases.expect: Both the Program and the Portfolio profiles are rejected and the container is routed out of WM-ACT-029.

cases.input: Adding a project lets program governance overwrite its baseline and actuals.
cases.expect: The mutation is rejected.

cases.input: A program tranche decision automatically advances a project phase.
cases.expect: The cascade is rejected.

cases.input: The same realized benefit is counted in both project and program totals.
cases.expect: The duplicate attribution is rejected; only WM-ACT-034-adjudicated shares are summed, per benefit identifier and observation period, to at most 1.0.

cases.input: The registry asserts WM-ACT-029 contains WM-ACT-005 as child identity while the profile claims external component mastership.
cases.expect: The containment edge is rejected; only a ProgramComponent membership assertion referencing an external master is lawful, and the profile does not cancel the inherited edge.

cases.input: A WM-ACT-029 instance is created with no profile discriminator.
cases.expect: Validation fails; the discriminator is non-null and mandatory.

cases.input: A WM-ACT-029 instance carries both the Program and the Portfolio discriminator.
cases.expect: Validation fails; exactly one discriminator is permitted and the profiles are disjoint.

cases.input: An existing Program instance is updated to the Portfolio discriminator, retaining its identity.
cases.expect: The in-place conversion is rejected; a profile change is supersession with new identity.

cases.input: BenefitDependency is given its own WM-* root code so that it can be addressed.
cases.expect: The allocation is rejected; addressability is satisfied by the composite assertion identity and no new root is minted.

cases.input: A ProgramComponent, a Tranche and a BenefitDependency are addressed within one program aggregate.
cases.expect: Each resolves as {program-id}--{artifact-kind}--{assertion-id}, is valid only inside that aggregate, and carries no independent root identity.

cases.input: An externally mastered operation is admitted as a program component alongside two projects.
cases.expect: Membership is recorded by reference to the external master; no WM-ACT-005 baseline, phase, gate or authorization semantics are inferred for the operation.

cases.input: Closing a component project automatically terminates its ProgramComponent assertion.
cases.expect: The inferred termination is rejected; membership ends only by an explicit, effective-dated, program-authored event.

cases.input: Program closure deletes the historical ProgramComponent, Tranche and BenefitDependency rows.
cases.expect: The deletion is rejected; historical assertions are retained through member closure and program closure.

cases.input: Closing the program sets the remaining components to closed.
cases.expect: The cascade is rejected; program closure neither closes, cancels nor deletes any member.

cases.input: Project closure emits a realized state for the joint benefit it contributes to.
cases.expect: The realization assertion is rejected; closure proves neither outcome nor benefit and the benefit remains forecast with absent-reason measurement-pending.

cases.input: A joint benefit is declared with owner, baseline, target and indicator but no falsifiable hypothesis.
cases.expect: The benefit is rejected; an explicit falsifiable results-chain hypothesis is required.

cases.input: Adjudicated contribution shares for one benefit and one observation period sum to 1.3.
cases.expect: The adjudication is rejected; adjudicated shares sum to at most 1.0 per benefit identifier and observation period.

cases.input: Unadjudicated contribution shares are reconciled and reported as realized attribution without a WM-ACT-034 judgment.
cases.expect: The report is rejected; attribution is adjudicated only by a WM-ACT-034 judgment and is never inferred from reconciliation or membership.

cases.input: A project appears as a component of two programs and attribution shares are derived from the dual membership.
cases.expect: Both memberships are valid; the derived attribution is rejected because membership implies neither mastership nor attribution.

cases.input: Adding a project to a Portfolio creates a ProgramComponent assertion on a sibling Program, or the reverse.
cases.expect: The propagation is rejected; Portfolio membership and Program membership are disjoint assertions.

cases.input: A released transition plan is treated as operational acceptance and the capability is reported as handed over.
cases.expect: The inference is rejected; operational acceptance is a separate authorized WM-ACT-034 decision by the receiving operational owner.

cases.input: Readiness and handover bindings on WM-ACT-029 carry a second copy of the WM-ACT-008 plan content.
cases.expect: The duplication is rejected; bindings are references to a pinned plan release.

cases.input: Program closure terminates the sustainment obligations recorded for the accepted capability.
cases.expect: The termination is rejected; sustainment obligations survive program closure and remain externally mastered.

cases.input: A released membership, allocation, decision or observation is edited in place to correct an error.
cases.expect: The mutation is rejected; released assertions are immutable and corrected only by an explicit successor.

cases.input: A BenefitDependency terminates on the external Outcome / Benefit Realization master, which has no allocated identifier.
cases.expect: The endpoint is recorded with absent-identifier reason identifier-unassigned; no identifier is minted and no realization claim is made.

cases.input: A transition plan release is pinned while program membership and results-chain assertions are revised.
cases.expect: The Program profile, each assertion kind and the transition plan version independently, and the pinned plan release is unaffected.
